query: select p.discord_user_id, p.trainer_name, $2::double precision + coalesce((select sum(a.delta_mu) from season_rating_adjustments a where a.player_id = p.id), 0::double precision) + coalesce((select sum(d.delta) from player_match_rating_deltas d where d.player_id = p.id), 0::double precision) as "rating!", coalesce((select count(*) from player_match_rating_deltas d where d.player_id = p.id), 0)::bigint as "matches!" from players p where p.id = $1
